referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This data set includes the material use for the manufacturing of the sanitary installations in the residental building according to Klingler and Kasser, 2011. The warm water production is not part of this data set. A washing machine and dryer are included. No kitchen equipment other than the sink are considered. 4 newly constructed multi-familiy residental buildings. The sanitary system has a life-span of 30 years. Transport is included. The average energy reference area ist 1293 m2.
